title: End of the unary generator loop
statement: Let $c,C,q$ be natural numbers with $q>0$. On empty input, start the unary polynomial generator in the loop state at level $c$, with every work-head position at $0$ and empty output, and with each work tape holding the unary word of length $q$. After $T_{c+1}(q,C)+1$ steps, where $T_0(q,C)=C+1$ and $T_{r+1}(q,C)=q(T_r(q,C)+2)+q+2$, the machine is halted, all work-head positions are again $0$, the work tapes still hold their initial contents, and the output consists of $Cq^{c+1}$ ones.
replaced:
On the empty input, with every unary loop tape of side $q > 0$ already
installed and all heads at $0$, the unary polynomial generator runs for
exactly one more step than the exact nest cost at level $c+1$ and halts,
having emitted $C\,q^{c+1}$ ones, with every loop head back at $0$.
